title: A Long Marathon
overview: This "One-Person-Crew" film tells a story of a female filmmaker who created a daring film about a gay couple, her courage is met not with conversation, but with violence. She gets threatened, humiliated, and abandoned by the very society she hoped to engage via her film. As she goes door to door seeking help, she is met only with humiliation. Pushed to the edge, she joins hands with a contract killer, who is secretly battling his own sexual problem. Together, they begin a dark campaign of vengeance, targeting those who wronged her. As they hunt down the culprits, things seem to settle down but one misstep by the killer throws her into a moral dilemma. Forced to confront the blurred line between justice and destruction, victimhood, and vengeance, she must decide how far she’s willing to go, and what she's willing to become.
